short_description: Learn to paddle in calm, protected waters just steps from The Royal Hawaiian.
cancellation_summary: Submit cancellation requests 48 hours prior for a refund.
meeting_point: Royal Hawaiian Hotel, 2259 Kalākaua Ave., Honolulu, HI 96815
description: Learn or advance your skills in stand-up paddling with a personalized one-on-one lesson. Whether you're a beginner mastering balance, paddling, and turning, or an advanced paddler ready to catch waves, this lesson will be tailored to your skill level. Paddle over the reef and keep an eye out for turtles as you explore Waikīkī's calm waters.
what_is_included:
- Stand-up paddleboard
- Rash guard
- 15-minute safety briefing
what_is_not_included:
- Towel
- Storage for personal items or valuables
itinerary:
- 15 minutes of safety instruction on the sand
- 1 hour of stand-up paddling with personalized coaching
highlights:
- Private one-on-one stand-up paddling lesson with an expert instructor
- Choose between beginner or advanced instruction
- Paddle in the beautiful waters of Waikīkī with a chance to see turtles
check_in_details: Check in at least 10-15 minutes before your lesson at the service counter.
special_requirements:
- Participants must be able to swim and be comfortable being submerged under the water.
- Children under 13 are not allowed to participate for safety reasons.
restrictions: - Pregnant women or guests with prior neck or back injuries should not participate.
extras:
- All instructors are CPR & lifeguard certified
- Photos & video available for purchase
faqs:
- **Do I need prior stand-up paddling or surfing experience?**
No, our Waikīkī Beach stand-up paddle lessons are perfect for beginners. We can tailor your lesson to meet your paddling level. 

- **Will all the equipment be provided?**
Yes, all equipment, including a stand-up paddleboard, paddle, and rash guard, will be provided.

- **Are children allowed to participate?**
No. Guests only 13 years of age or older may participate in a stand-up paddle lesson. 

- **We have more than one person and wish to book multiple one-on-one lessons at the same time slot., but we do not see availability online. Can you help?**
Please email us at info@waikikibeachservices.com with 1) The number of students (over 13 years old), 2) Preferred date and time of your lesson (choose three) 3) Your full contact information (email address & cell phone number). Once we have received your message, we will contact you within one business day. 

- **How far is the walk to the water? Will I have to carry equipment?** 
Waikīkī Beach Services at the Royal Hawaiian is located right on the beach. The water is feet away from where you will check in for your lesson. No carrying equipment long distances, no cutting into your time in the water.
